title: Haidar E Karrar Ali
body:
Ya Ali Maola - Ali -5 ×2
Rasulallah S.W.A.W Farmate Hain Ke Mai Aor Ali Ek Hi Noor Se Hun Jo Ali Se Mohabbat Krta Hai Wo Mujh Se Mohabbat Karta Hai Aor Jo Mujhse Mohabbat Karta Hai Wo Khuda Se Mohabbat Karta Hai Ali Se Mohabbat Momin Ki Pahechan Hai Aor Ali Se Nafrat Munafikat Ki Pahechan Hai
Haider E Karrar Ali -3 ×2
Kar Kar Ke Sajde Hamko Bataya Hai Ali Ne Makhluk Mai Hun Rab Hai Mera Qadiro Ghaffar Momin Ke Dil Me Raheta Hun Har Ek Ghadi Mai Mere Wela Se Sirf Munafik Ko Hai Inkar
Ali -5
Haider -8

Haider -8

Haider -8

1. Han Peshwa Han Rahenuma Wo Ala Nasab Hai
Yasubuddin E Khuda Uska Laqab Hai
Pakiza Hai Kirdar Han Waliyo Ka Sardar
Ek Ahni Diwar Jarrar O Karrar
Sahibe Kirdar Ali -3

Imamul Muttaqin Jise Kahe Gaye Nabi
Islam Ka Waqr, Mazloom Ki Pukar, Do Dhari Talwar, Khaliq Ka Shahkar,
Iman Ka Memar Ali -3

3. Thokar Se Apne Murde Jilate Hain Ya Ali
Fazle Khuda Se Mohiyo Momeet Hai Ya Ali
Sayaye Kirdigar, Khaliq Ka Shahkar, Allah Ka Anwar, Ek Banda Ba Waqar,
Naze Zee Waqar Ali -3
Rab Se Jurhae Tar Ali -3
Apna Hai Sarkar Ali.............
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Serate Mustaqeem Tu Hi Saqiye Kaosar
Qaseemunnar Wl Janna Tu Hi Aye Mere Rahebar
Shafahe Maheshar, Saqiye Kaosar, Gaohare Mimbar,
Khushbuw E Gulzar Ali -3
Mamba E Anwar Ali -3
Apna Hai Sardar Ali.............
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Har Ek Bani Hashim Tha Wahan Saniye Haider
Bechain Tha Ye Soch Ke Batil Ka Wo Lashkar
Karbal Ka Wo Manzar, Aor Ale Payambbar, Akbar Me Bhi Haider, Asghar Me Bhi Haider,
Karte The Yalghar Ali -3
Ghazi Alamdar Ali -3
Apna Hai Sardar Ali .............
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ajiz Hun Mai Aosafe Ali Kaise Likhun Mai
Dariya E Jahan Kis Taraha Kuze Me Bharun Mai
Azam Kare Izhar, Mumkin Hi Nahi Yar,
Parvez Ki Pukar, Ajaeb Ka Tu Bharmar,
Ham Sab Ka Hai Dildar Ali -3
Kahete Hain Hubdar Ali -3
Apna Hai Sarkar Ali.............
